scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on their account and requesting a refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is DeShawn Jefferson and I'm 66. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Okay, I see you're asking about a charge. Can you tell me the exact date and the merchant name for this $76 transaction?
It was two days ago, on the 14th, and the merchant is listed as 'Global Tech Solutions'.
Right, I see it. Look, I don't have the tools to verify if this was a mistake or not. You'll have to talk to someone else about this. I'm just going to escalate this to our billing specialist team.
Oh, I see. Can you at least tell me if I need to do anything else, or if my account is safe from further charges?
I already told you I'm escalating it. You'll get an email eventually. I can't really do anything else right now.

escalation_reason: Agent failed to perform standard verification or investigation, citing lack of tools and inability to handle the request.
